_comment: web-basics scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A coding-capable chat model is what you want. Point at a local model (LM
Studio / llama.cpp / Ollama) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; see
No build tools needed for the basics -- you write .html/.css files and open
them in a browser. There is nothing to compile, so no testCommand.
snapshots let you /undo an edit; pathFence keeps writes in this workspace.
